prerequisites: Learning content of the courses from the first semester of phase 1.

learning_outcomes.text: The student defines and describes the operation of the concepts and components of digital systems. He/she compares different concepts and components with each other.
The student designs simple and complex structured digital circuits on an FPGA-based board, using VHDL.
The student designs, implements, and tests a circuit.
The student designs and assembles a structured digital circuit, consisting of various sub-components.
The student tests his/her digital products with a testbench. He/she interprets the results of the simulation in order to determine solutions for any problems.

assessment_methods.method: Written exam (multiple choice, open questions, closed questions) for Digital Systems - basic: theory
Written exam for Digital Systems - basic: lab

assessment_rules: The overall grade is on a 1-20 scale, based on the theory and lab parts. The distribution between theory and lab is according to ECTS credits. For the first examination opportunity in June, both Digital Systems 1: theory and Digital Systems 1: lab are 100% written exams. For resits in August, both Digital Systems 1: theory and Digital Systems 1: lab are 100% written exams. Partial transfers are possible for successful results in Digital Systems - basic: theory (YT5887) and Digital Systems - basic: lab (YT5888) within and across academic years.
